purpose: Immutable qualification receipt for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 serving with the Infernal Invocation r2 source composition

validation_environment.topology: Four RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs attached through independent CPU root ports
validation_environment.scheduler: MAX_NUM_SEQS=8, max model length 131072, max batched tokens 8192
validation_environment.comparison_policy: Performance results are valid for the recorded host and GPU set; switched-PCIe-host measurements are not interchangeable.

tests.docker_helper_contracts: pass: shell helper, Compose, source-composition, patched-NCCL, and 14 focused Python tests
tests.runtime_imports: pass: vLLM, B12X, FlashInfer, InstantTensor, LMCache, XGrammar, CUDA libraries, and patched NCCL
tests.fixed_k5: pass: startup, arithmetic correctness, C1/C8 sustained decode, uncached 64k prefill, target FULL CUDA graphs, and DSpark FULL CUDA graphs
tests.fixed_k7: pass: startup, arithmetic correctness, eight target FULL CUDA graph sizes, and eight DSpark FULL CUDA graph sizes
tests.dynamic_k7: pass: startup, arithmetic correctness, compact varlen capacity verification, 30 target FULL CUDA graphs, and 56 DSpark FULL CUDA graphs
tests.lmcache_tiered_kv: pass: four LMCache workers, bounded L1, filesystem L2, local prefix reset, L1 eviction, and L2 replay
tests.native_tiered_kv: pass: native CPU cache, filesystem L2, local prefix reset, eviction, and L2 replay
tests.runtime_error_scan: pass: no traceback, engine initialization failure, CUDA runtime error, or GPU fault signature in qualified logs

fixed_probabilistic_k7.cuda_graphs: Target and DSpark execution each captured eight FULL graph sizes.

dynamic_probabilistic_k7.cuda_graphs: Target execution captured 30 FULL graphs and DSpark execution captured 56 FULL graphs across scheduler rows and draft depths.

lmcache_tiered_kv.conditions: TP4/DCP1, MTP0, 4 GiB aggregate L1, 8 GiB filesystem L2, 512-token chunks, six churn requests, and a 15-second writeback interval

native_tiered_kv.conditions: TP4/DCP1, MTP0, 1 GiB CPU cache, 8 GiB filesystem L2, six churn requests, and a 15-second writeback interval

limitations: K5 performance was measured on one four-GPU root-port host; the receipt does not claim identical throughput on a PCIe-switch topology.
Fixed K7 and dynamic K7 are functionally and graph qualified. Their workload-specific throughput and quality are not promoted over fixed probabilistic K5 by this receipt.
The dynamic K7 request exercised compact varlen verification at depth seven. It does not prove that every confidence profile transitions through every supported draft depth.
LMCache and native KV offload were qualified with speculative decoding disabled so cache movement and draft acceptance remained independent variables.
VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE was enabled only for validation-time local prefix reset. The published Compose profile leaves it disabled.
